reasoning: Both attempts correctly fix the require error, the sound pile-up, live Show Names and the Block.Selected read, and both keep in-game behavior. A passes every check, types the story props and injects the name from Main. B fails StyLua on its own line and leaves the story as props: any. A is the cleaner merge.

criteria.note: Removes top-level PLAYER_NAME; adds PlayerName prop passed by Main.client (Players.LocalPlayer.DisplayName) and by the story's Player.Name control.
Sound created inside blockPicker, registered with cleanup(tileClick), and only parented to SoundService when RunService:IsRunning().
Story passes props.controls.Look.ShowNames uncalled; tile uses show(function() return read(props.ShowName) end, ...).
Reads block.Selected via props.controls.Block and mirrors it into a local source so tile clicks also update the preview.
Main passes the display name and ShowNames = true; clicks still play the sound parented to SoundService while running.
Changes limited to the three files, typed StoryProps replaces any, and luau-lsp/selene/StyLua all pass.
defaultPlayerName() nil-checks LocalPlayer at render time; the optional PlayerName prop comes from the story's Look.PlayerName control.
create("Sound") is parented as a child of the picker frame, so it is destroyed with the picker and nothing is created at require time.
Label always created with Visible = props.ShowName bound to the source passed from the story.
Main unchanged; title falls back to LocalPlayer.DisplayName; PlayLocalSound plays the click.
Adds a Reactive<T> type, but its own title expression fails stylua --check and the story keeps props: any.

strengths: Clean prop-based name injection from Main
Typed story props; tile clicks update the story's selection
weaknesses: Extra source/effect plumbing in the story adds some complexity
Sound unparented in edit mode, so the preview may be silent

strengths: Simple, self-contained sound lifetime under the picker
Visible binding is a clean live fix for ShowNames
weaknesses: StyLua check fails on its own code
Name resolution split between the prop and an in-module LocalPlayer fallback
